effect_description_eng: ＜Blocker＞ ＜Retaliation＞ [When Digivolving] Your opponent trashes any 1 card from their hand or security stack. [On Deletion] If your opponent's hand has 7 or fewer cards, you may play 1 play cost 7 or lower purple Digimon card with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits from your trash without paying the cost. (Rule) Trait: Has [Birdkin] Type.
